positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: While working with their client company at Leaf, I interpreted requirements and implemented solutions for the client as a full-stack developer while maintaining and managing SQL and Firestore databases, Kubernetes clusters, and app services in Azure. I would also participate in weekly meetings with members of the client’s C-suite to discuss priority and progress for features and advise on the technical direction of the project.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Front-End Development · Entity Framework · .NET Framework · .NET Core · Kubernetes · Node.js · Software Infrastructure · Full-Stack Development · Datadog · Git · Microsoft Azure · Docker Products · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Business Intelligence Developer
positions.description: As a member of the Decision Support System team, I work to support the business in its various research and analytical endeavors. My team's work includes developing applications to be used by internal customers, creating and managing SQL databases, and interpreting and organizing data into datasets for use by analysts. I often work with both the R&D and IT departments, so I have an in-depth knowledge of both business and IT practices and often help to mediate discussions between the two departments.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Entity Framework · .NET Framework · .NET Core · Git · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Assistant Language Teacher
positions.description: I travelled to two elementary schools, a middle school, a kindergarten, and a special needs school in the area to teacher English. At school, I taught classes alongside a Japanese teacher, with whom I discussed lesson plans beforehand. Outside of school, I was also responsible for planning the lessons. At the elementary schools, this also means deciding the curriculum for the year. In addition, the board of education for Tsu holds regular meetings for English teachers to meet and discuss ideas to use in the classroom, and I have been selected to present and lead discussion at these meetings on several occasions.

positions.title: Research Experience for Undergraduates
positions.description: I worked with Dr. Timothy Wright on a mobile security app for iOS that determines the security risk while browsing the Internet. The app was still in early stages while I was working on it, so my main duty was to provide functionality to record threats that the app detected, which would be key in testing the approach that the app used to determine what is considered a threat. In addition, I would test the app and provide any feedback to Dr. Wright with regard to bugs and other problems that I found.

volunteerExperiences.description: Carmel has a sister city relationship that fosters cultural exchange with Kawachinagano, a city in Japan near Osaka. I joined the volunteer group for the relationship shortly after moving to Carmel and began giving my time and talents to help plan events and manage booths at the events for the group. I have been involved in planning social events for the group, assisting artists visiting from Kawachinagano to sell their art at the Carmel International Arts Festival, joining a delegation to visit our sister city in Japan for the 30th anniversary of the sister city relationship, and helping to plan and execute a new annual Japanese spring festival. In August of 2024, I stepped up to take the role of treasurer for the group. As a member of the executive committee, I have been working on modernizing and streamlining aspects of the group, including setting up a business PayPal account, leveraging tools in Gmail and Google Drive to keep the group organized, and updating the group's web page.
Help by walking dogs and playing with cats under the direction of the animal handlers. Record activities such as hours volunteered, which dogs were walked, and whether any dogs were given treats.

projects.title: ChatBot
projects.description: A Python desktop application that connects to OpenAI’s API and manages conversations with AI assistants. Users can create and save conversations with personalized assistants, giving them instructions to change how they interact with the user. The app currently has a simple interface written using PyQt that allows users to create, save, and load conversations with different assistants, conversation history with timestamps that is maintained between sessions, and input and output with both voice and text. I am also working on developing functionality to make the AI proactive in conversations rather than just reacting to user inputs.

projects.title: Pokemon Zuka
projects.description: This is a project that I wanted to make on my own. Given the massive amounts of data relating to the Pokemon games, I wanted to create a program that could help to organize the information and make decision making easier for players. Using C# and SQL, Pokemon Zukan retrieves information from the database and presents it to the user in a fun and easy to understand interface.

organizations.name: Japan Club
organizations.position: Secretary, Assistant Vice President · Aug 2010 - May 2014
organizations.description: I was the Assistant Vice President for the 2012-2013 academic school year, and the secretary for the 2013-2014 academic school year. In both roles, I worked with other officers to plan and lead events throughout the school year, discussing new ideas for cultural experiences that the club could offer for members. More specifically, as the Assistant Vice President, I helped to cover some of the duties of the Vice President, such as corresponding with the Japanese department to help spread interest in Japan, while she was studying in Japan. As the secretary, I wrote and sent a weekly news letter to the Japan club list server to talk about upcoming events and raise interest in the activities we had planned.
